subject: spanish
title: Spain vs Latin America
welcome_lead: Spanish unites continents but identity differs. Spain vs Latin America — language, history, culture diverge.
meta_desc: Spanish: comparison Spain vs Latin America.

concepts.def: Mixing of European, Indigenous, African heritage.

walkthroughs.body_html: Columbus 1492. Cortes overthrows Aztecs 1521. Pizarro defeats Incas 1533. Three centuries of colonial rule shape the language.
Bolivar, San Martin, Sucre lead independence (1810-1825). New nations inherit Spanish language, Catholic religion, but indigenous and African presences shape distinct identities.
Latin America's identity emerges from mestizaje — biological and cultural mixing. Octavio Paz explores this in El laberinto de la soledad (1950).
